ar.title: اللحم بالفلفل الأخضر

steps.n1: يقطع اللحم مع البصل والفلفل الأخضر شرائح.
steps.n2: يحمر اللحم في الزيت أو السمن ثم يرفع جانبا.
steps.n3: يضاف البصل ويشوح، ثم يضاف الفلفل الأخضر ويضافان للحم، ويتبلان بالملح والفلفل مع إضافة قليل من الماء كلما احتاج، مع تغطيته حتى النضج.

en.title: Meat with Green Peppers
en.intro: This is a traditional Egyptian dish prepared with fresh ingredients and aromatic spices.

steps.n1: Slice the meat along with the onion and green peppers.
steps.n2: Brown the meat in oil or ghee, then set it aside.
steps.n3: Add the onion and sauté, then add the green peppers, return the meat to the pot, and season with salt and pepper, adding a little water as needed, covered, until cooked through.

legacySteps: Slice the meat along with the onion and green peppers.
Brown the meat in oil or ghee, then set it aside.
Add the onion and sauté, then add the green peppers, return the meat to the pot, and season with salt and pepper, adding a little water as needed, covered, until cooked through.
